title: Create API client for chat endpoints
description:
Create react_ui/src/api/client.ts as the API client module for chat endpoints.

Export these functions:
- createSession(): POST to /api/sessions/, returns Promise<CreateSessionResponse>
- sendMessage(message: string, sessionId: string): POST to /api/chat/, body { message, session_id }, returns Promise<ChatResponse>
- sendMessageStream(message: string, sessionId: string, onEvent: (event: StreamEvent) => void): fetch /api/chat/stream with ReadableStream, parse SSE events, call onEvent for each, return Promise<void>

Use fetch API. Base URL defaults to '' (empty string, relying on Vite proxy in dev and nginx in production). Parse JSON responses. Throw typed errors when response is not ok: read the JSON error body and construct ApiError.

Import types from '../types': CreateSessionResponse, ChatResponse, StreamEvent, ApiError.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- react_ui/src/types.ts

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed paths. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed files modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
acceptance_criteria: createSession, sendMessage, sendMessageStream functions are exported
sendMessage sends POST to /api/chat/ with correct JSON body
sendMessageStream parses SSE from a ReadableStream response
Error responses are handled with typed ApiError rejection
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: add third-party dependencies not already in package.json
